sourceScope: Actual client src/scripts, desktop src/scripts/tests, MCP src/tests/examples and package/config files; independent of ignored test outputs
buildProvenance: Existing WASM and release native binaries; no build, Rust test, GUI or GPU run
commandNotation: Repository-relative arguments; external executable placeholders are supplied by FINAL_CPU_NODE/FINAL_CPU_PYTHON. Actual versions and fixture hashes are recorded.
runtimeIdentityScope: Explicit selected desktop dist, its manifest, release native executables, public/generated WASM and font; all remain strict before/after guards

sharedDefaultDistObservation.scope: Separate observation; never a native execution input. The explicitly selected artifact remains strictly guarded even if the same directory is selected. Changes to any selected artifact/source/WASM/release binary still invalidate the run.
